---
title: "Injury-homeostasis axis"
output: html_document
---

The axis was defined from the shared covariance structure of 13 meta-program
activities. The processed inputs contain the pooled meta-program correlation
matrix, principal-component loadings, permutation result and protein-level
axis associations. The analysis reproduces the clustered correlation map,
axis orientation, and the injury- and homeostasis-associated protein sets.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "07_injury_homeostasis_axis.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/07_injury_homeostasis_axis/axis_summary.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The signature table and figure are written to
`analysis/07_injury_homeostasis_axis/`.
